summary: Retest of the updated acceptance matrix (hero now pt-121/sm:pb-12 with min-h 100svh + justify-center, dark comparison band, consistent section headers) plus full prior regression. Updated hero-fills-first-screen and section-rhythm-padding to measure gap EQUALITY (nav-bottom -> hero content top vs hero bottom -> hero content bottom) via the hero's non-decorative direct children instead of the old fixed 80/80px assertion -- both now pass with exact 117.19px/117.19px (1440x900) and 48px/48px (1280x720) symmetry, and the 3-line headline text is verified. Added 2 new browser checks: comparison-dark-band-contrast (home-compare bg rgb(31,31,34), white heading, white table card, axe-clean contrast, distinct light home-marketplace that follows) and section-headers-consistency (identical h2 48px/700/line-height/letter-spacing at 1440 and 36px at 390 across all 6 sections, identical pill eyebrow style). Regenerated the expired Clerk sign-in ticket for auth-entry-signed-in. Backend pytest suite (4 cases: 3 signups + 1 design-kit zip) passes. All 26 named regression/new browser checks pass (links-navigate-correctly flaked once on a transient dev-server 429 rate-limit, passed clean on rerun). One check run directly against the public preview ingress URL as a smoke test. 0 bugs found.
